summary: QA Bug Fix Verification (Iteration 33). All 12 bug fixes verified working correctly. Tested: Salary Calculator loads (no 404), Rent vs Buy empty state + Full Analysis, Retirement Growth age field clearing, Bill Split subtotal=0 message + tip percentage display, Freelancer Tax Planner UI (no overflow), Year-End Packet dual Download buttons.
passed_tests: Salary Calculator: /calculators/salary-calculator loads correctly (no 404)
Salary Calculator: Shows Annual Take-Home breakdown ($51,600 with default values)
Salary Calculator: Shows Monthly breakdown ($4,300)
Salary Calculator: Shows Bi-weekly breakdown ($1,985)
Salary Calculator: Shows Hourly breakdown ($24.81)
Salary Calculator: Has Deduction Breakdown section with Tax, Retirement, Health Insurance
Rent vs Buy Calculator: Full Analysis section visible with default values
Rent vs Buy Calculator: 'If You Buy' comparison shows Monthly Mortgage, Property Tax, Insurance + Maintenance, Total Monthly, Home Value After 10yr, Total Cost
Rent vs Buy Calculator: 'If You Rent + Invest' comparison shows Monthly Rent, Monthly Savings vs Buying, Down Payment Invested, Monthly Savings Invested, Total Renter Wealth
Rent vs Buy Calculator: Shows wealth comparison summary ('Buying builds $X more wealth')
Rent vs Buy Calculator: Empty state 'Enter rent and home price to see the comparison' shows when both rent=0 and price=0
Rent vs Buy Calculator: Full Analysis hidden when values are empty
Retirement Growth Calculator: Current Age field can be cleared to empty
Retirement Growth Calculator: Can type new value (25) in Current Age field after clearing
Retirement Growth Calculator: Retirement Age field can be cleared to empty
Retirement Growth Calculator: Can type new value (70) in Retirement Age field after clearing
Bill Split Tool: Shows 'Enter a bill amount above to see the split' when subtotal=0
Bill Split Tool: Tip shows with percentage in parentheses - 'Includes $0.00 tax and $15.00 tip (15%)'
Bill Split Tool: Settlement Summary calculates correctly with $100 subtotal + 15% tip = $115.00 total
Freelancer Tax Planner: All stat cards display without overflow (Annual Gross, Annual Expenses, Annual Net, SE Tax, Est. Total Tax, Est. Take-Home)
Freelancer Tax Planner: Large numbers ($11,999,988) display correctly without breaking layout
Freelancer Tax Planner: Quarterly Set-Aside section displays correctly
Freelancer Tax Planner: Q1-Q4 quarterly payment cards display correctly
Year-End Tax Packet: Top Download PDF button visible next to disclaimer (data-testid='download-packet-btn-top')
Year-End Tax Packet: Bottom Download Year-End Tax Packet (PDF) button visible (data-testid='download-packet-btn')
Year-End Tax Packet: IRS prep disclaimer visible with warning icon
Backend /api/health: Returns {"status":"healthy","message":"RealProfits API is running"}
critical_code_review_comments: SalaryCalculator.tsx: New component properly calculates annual, monthly, bi-weekly, hourly take-home with tax, retirement, and insurance deductions
RentVsBuyCalculator.tsx: hasData check (rent > 0 || price > 0) correctly controls empty state vs Full Analysis display
RetirementGrowthCalculator.tsx: Age inputs use value={currentAge || ''} pattern allowing empty string before retyping
BillSplitTool.tsx: multiplier = subtotalVal > 0 ? grandTotal / subtotalVal : 0 prevents division issues when subtotal=0
BillSplitTool.tsx: Tip display includes percentage in parentheses format
FreelancerTaxPlanner.tsx: Uses text-xl and break-all classes to prevent overflow on stat cards
YearEndPacket.tsx: Has two Download buttons - one at top (download-packet-btn-top) and one at bottom (download-packet-btn)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All QA bug fixes from iteration 33 verified working. Key implementations: (1) SalaryCalculator is a new component at /calculators/salary-calculator with full take-home breakdown, (2) RentVsBuyCalculator shows empty state when rent=0 AND price=0, Full Analysis section shows 'If You Buy' vs 'If You Rent + Invest' comparison, (3) RetirementGrowthCalculator age fields use value={age || ''} pattern for clearing, (4) BillSplitTool uses multiplier=0 when subtotal=0 and shows tip with percentage in parentheses, (5) FreelancerTaxPlanner uses text-xl and break-all to prevent overflow, (6) YearEndPacket has dual Download buttons at top and bottom.
